# CopperMCP

> A local-first, open-source PCB automation platform. It lets an AI client read a KiCad board as
> typed, exact-integer geometry, propose routes and placements, and validate them against
> authoritative KiCad DRC — without ever letting the model write copper. Every generated result is
> an immutable candidate bound to an exact board revision until a human explicitly applies it.

CopperMCP is an MCP server (28 tools over stdio, 27 over streamable-http) plus a CLI over the same
application services. The
non-negotiable boundary: AI may interpret constraints and propose net ordering, corridors, cost
weights, and repairs; deterministic code owns geometry, connectivity, DRC, provenance, and file
mutation. Exactly two operations modify a file, both off by default behind an operator environment
flag plus an operation-scoped single-use token that no model can mint.

CopperMCP is MVP-alpha. Unverified values are modelled as explicit one-value literals (`not_run`,
`not_modelled`, `inconclusive`) rather than implied, and every refusal is typed and non-echoing.
Read the non-claims before relying on any result.

## Agent contract

- [Driving CopperMCP as an AI agent](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/agents.md): the canonical agent-facing usage contract — tool-by-tool bindings, every refusal code as an action to take next, digest discipline, end-to-end workflows, and the one-value literals. Start here.
- [MCP API contract](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/architecture/mcp-api.md): the tool surface in contract terms, including structured inputs, output unions, and resource URIs.
- [Usage guide](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/usage.md): every CLI command and MCP tool, with the limits each one declares.

## Project

- [README](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/README.md): what CopperMCP does and, just as prominently, what it does not claim.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/README.md): what every document owns.
- [Architecture overview](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/architecture/overview.md): system boundaries and layer responsibilities.
- [Security and threat model](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/architecture/security-model.md): assets, adversaries, boundaries, and the invariants that keep untrusted input contained.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md): what comes next.

## Contracts

- [Board IR and KiCad adapter contract](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/architecture/board-ir.md): the canonical exact-integer board snapshot and the narrow read-only KiCad converter.
- [Circuit Intent IR and KiCad schematic contract](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/architecture/circuit-intent.md): the logical topology contract and deterministic schematic rendering.
- [Deterministic A* routing baseline](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/architecture/routing-baseline.md): the candidate-only CPU reference router.
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/adr/README.md): durable decisions and their tradeoffs.

## Optional

- [KiCad IPC observer plugin](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/hardware/kicad-ipc-plugin/README.md): installing the read-only PCB-editor plugin from KiCad's Plugin and Content Manager, and why installing it grants nothing until `COPPER_MCP_ALLOW_LIVE_IPC=1`.
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to propose a change.
- [Repository instructions for coding agents](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the contributor contract, distinct from the tool-usage contract above.
- [Project ledgers](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/docs/ledgers/README.md): append-only decision, risk, security, benchmark, and release records.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/seunghyukchoe/copper-mcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): notable changes, Keep a Changelog format.
